name: view_duel_client_commit_matches_contract
description: The client's commitment is the contract's (contract-m7.md §2 and §3): for the same inputs Game.duel_commit and the simulation's SimUndertow.commit give the same digests, pinned to those worked out apart from the game (Python's hashlib over the contract's bytes: the seed as 4 bytes big-endian, the seat, the window and the pack as a byte each, the salt's halves as 4 bytes big-endian each; the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 as two signed 32-bit halves). On Undertow's own rules, in window 9 (two corks; reached by playing wave 8) two packs are corked: each CORK carries tier III and only the commit, and the salts stay on this machine, kept by bottle through a resync (the views built again and Game attached again, as a RESYNC does). The salts are the test's fixed ones (Game.salt_source, so two runs commit alike), pinned here too; without the seam a salt is 8 bytes from Crypto, two never alike. Uncorked with Space during wave 9, the simulation takes each reveal: each UNCORK reveals the pack and the salt its CORK committed to. A new match forgets them.

steps.msg: a duel of seed 20261101 against the caretaker
the seed and my seat as the commitment counts them
Game's commit and SimUndertow.commit for the contract's own case, salt 0x89ABCDEF 0x01234567, are the digest worked out apart
and for a zero salt and the extreme halves
4 bytes big-endian read as the signed i32 with their bits
in play a salt is 8 bytes from Crypto; the test's fixed salts are the pinned ones
both hollows to wave 7 in the first window: the next horn plays wave 8
window 9: two corks, tier III's price

steps.assert: corks.size() == 2 and corks[0][1] == 2 and corks[1][1] == 2 and Game.gold == 130
steps.msg: two CORKs of tier III, each charged
two commitments, no two alike, the first to the first fixed salt

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 2 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[1]['known'] and not Game.bottles_of(1)[0].has('pack')
steps.msg: both salts kept here, by bottle; the simulation holds no pack

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 2 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[1]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == Game.drift_packs()[0]
steps.msg: a resync (Game attached again) keeps them
Space uncorked both, and the simulation took both reveals
the UNCORKs reveal the fixed salts, oldest first
each UNCORK reveals the salt its CORK committed to, by the contract's bytes
a new match forgets the salts
